hostile_spawn_control.screen.title: Hostile Spawn Control
hostile_spawn_control.screen.read_only: Connected to a remote server: showing local settings only. Ask an operator to use /spawncontrol.
hostile_spawn_control.source.natural.des: Night, cave, Nether, End and biome spawning, including chunk-generation spawns, phantoms, and ongoing spawns inside structures such as swamp huts and Nether fortresses.
hostile_spawn_control.source.structure.d: Mobs placed when a structure generates: swamp hut witch, monument elder guardians, mansion illagers, end city shulkers, ocean ruin drowned, zombified piglins from Nether portals.
hostile_spawn_control.source.event.desc: Raids, pillager patrols, zombie sieges, dragon respawn, building a Wither, Wardens from shriekers, infested/oozing effects, endermites from ender pearls, skeleton traps.
Converted from another mob: villager to witch, zombie to drowned, skeleton to stray, piglin to zombified piglin... The original mob stays when blocked.
hostile_spawn_control.source.spawn_egg.d: Spawn eggs used by players or dispensers. Blocked eggs are not consumed.
commands.hostile_spawn_control.list.head: Hostile mobs (%s) - disabled spawn sources:
commands.hostile_spawn_control.status: %s hostile mobs, %s with restrictions, %s spawn attempts blocked since start
